item.title: Jake's Fireworks Recalls World Class Fireworks "Skull Strobe" Rockets Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Explosion and Burn Hazards
item.company: Fireworks stores nationwide from March 2025 through June 2026 for between $12 and $25.
item.brand: Fireworks stores nationwide from March 2025 through June 2026 for between $12 and $25.
item.summary: This recall involves World Class Fireworks "Skull Strobe" rockets. The rockets are mounted on a wooden stick and come in a black box with a picture of a skull, the brand name, the product name and a warning label. The SKU code 1004351 is found near the bottom of the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: World Class Fireworks "Skull Strobe" Rockets.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the fireworks rockets immediately and contact Jake's Fireworks for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to return the fireworks devices to the retail location where they purchased the product or the nearest Jake's Fireworks retail location.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
